name: A. H. Arnett
role: Partner in Arnett & Thomas, owners of the AHA brand
bio: A. H. Arnett was a partner in Arnett & Thomas, owners of the ΛHΛ brand, with a Dickinson post office, who published their brand in the Cow Boy in November 1885. He represented the brand at the April 1886 stockgrowers' meeting, and that May the firm added about 30 Hereford bulls to its herd.

moments.label: Added about 30 full-blood Hereford bulls to the herd
